name: H-498 Chinese knot (中国结)

origin.basis: Chaoyang is the bicycle-tire brand of ZC Rubber (Zhongce); sold by the official 朝阳轮胎官方旗舰店 on Tmall.

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Chaoyang's 'Chinese knot' themed folding road tire sold under its own item code.
weight_basis: The official listing gives no weights.

availability.note: Sold by Chaoyang's official Tmall store; other regions were not checked.

price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01 for the 28C folding option; coupon price CNY 117. Single or pair not stated.

caveats: Some sellers write "H496/498"; the official store lists H-498 under its own item code, but its relationship to the H-496 is not documented.
Weights, TPI and pressure limits of the folding version are not published.
The official store also sells 60 TPI wire-bead versions in 25-32 mm (CNY 80-85), which are entry-level tires outside this comparison.

image.shown: Chaoyang's poster for the H-498 Chinese knot, listing 700x25C to 32C sizes; the folding and wire-bead versions are not distinguished.
image.alt: Chaoyang Chinese knot H-498 road tire poster with the tire and size list

rights.usage_note: A photo from a public Xiaohongshu post, shown from Xiaohongshu with a link to the original post; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model; questions, seller and maker replies, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out.

checks.note: Official launch and seller posts only
